messages:
Sophia: Quick sync to finalize a compact Design Partner (DP) onboarding packet for recruitment. Need: short qual form, SE onboarding checklist, 1-page partner summary, and launch acceptance criteria.

Matt: Love it. Paste the checklist here and Ill trim to a single page.

Sophia: Draft checklist:
- Intro & expectations (roles, time)
- Quick qual form (contact, volume, data sensitivity)
- SE onboarding steps (API keys, SSO, test data upload)
- Supported integrations (Webhook / VPC / SSO) - partner must pick one
- Feedback cadence (weekly 30m + async issues)
- Success signals & telemetry access
- Launch acceptance + rollback criteria
- Credits + 2 office hours/month

Elaine: Add gates: requires internal champion (PM/Eng lead) and >=3mo commitment. High sensitivity -> Private track.

Kevin: Ops needs: response SLA (ack 24h business, triage 72h), and a smoke test pre-launch (1k requests over 24h; 95p latency target by model family). Will post a small curl script.

Oscar: Research: we want a canonical prompt set (5 prompts per flow) uploaded monthly to measure regressions. Ill prepare a rubric.

Jane: Ill mock the 1-pager and a Notion layout. Share a link when ready.

Sophia: Feedback template to include: one-line summary; flows tested; repro steps + minimal prompt; expected vs actual; severity; impact; suggestion.

Matt: Recruitment fields suggestion: primary contact + role, est monthly requests, primary use-case + 3 metrics, data sensitivity, commitment length (3/6/12).

Elaine: Good. Ill add triage labels and own intake for the first 4 weeks.

Kevin: Also require partners to opt into an integration path during intake; VPC selections trigger a network review.

Sophia: Non-goal to state in packet: no ad-hoc feature additions mid-beta except safety/critical fixes.

dp-coordinator-bot: Reminder: DP weekly sync created Tue 11:00 starting next week. Invites sent.

Sophia: Launch acceptance checklist (to include): partner sign-off in Notion; smoke test pass (1k / 24h, 95p latency target); error rate <1% over 24h; no critical regressions on canonical prompts; SE + partner agree to go-live window.

Matt: Ill draft outreach email + 1-pager today and post to Notion.

Oscar: Uploaded prompt sets and rubric to Notion.

Jane: One-pager mock uploaded.

Elaine: Labels created; first intake scheduled for Friday.

Sophia: Actions recap: Matt - outreach + 1-pager; Jane - visual mock; Elaine - intake triage + labels; Kevin - smoke script + latency targets; Oscar - prompt set; Sophia - final packet. If no objections by EOD we start recruiting next week.

Matt: :thumbsup:

Elaine: Approved from intake side.

Sophia: Thanks all. Moving detailed edits to Notion; use this thread for quick status only. :thumbsup:
